metadata.name: Supabase API
metadata.description:
Overview: A database-as-API backend with isolated Deno Edge Functions and shared utilities.
When to avoid: Avoid when domain logic is too heavy for SQL and thin edge shims, or when long-running jobs are central.
Layers: Database schema and RLS, RPCs, isolated Edge Functions, shared function utilities, and generated types.

rules.diagnostic: An Edge Function crosses the function-isolation boundary by importing a sibling function.
rules.remediation: Move shared behavior into supabase/functions/_shared and import it from there.
